events.what: World Youth Day Seoul 2027, 3 to 8 August, with the Pope in attendance. Days in the Dioceses run across Korea from 29 July to 2 August. Organisers expect up to a million people at the closing Mass.
events.effect: Major event: peak prices and crowds; accommodation in Seoul will be very tight

sources.title: The WYD Seoul 2027 will take place from 3 to 8 August 2027
sources.authority: Dicastery for Laity, Family and Life (Holy See)

laws.rule: Seoul has declared many outdoor public places smoke-free, including bus stops and the area within 10 metres of every subway station exit (from 1 May 2016). The city's own page lists the 10 metre zone; it is a dated 2016 notice, so the current list of sites isn't confirmed here.
laws.penalty_signal: Seoul's 2016 notice gives a fine of 100,000 won for smoking inside a subway-exit zone. Not converted to AUD (no dated rate held).

sources.title: No Smoking Signs at Subway Station Entrances, Effective May 1
sources.supports: 10 m subway-exit smoke-free zone and the 100,000 won fine (page dated 4 May 2016)

sources.title: The Smoke is Clearing from Public Spaces in Seoul
sources.supports: outdoor and indoor smoke-free areas incl. bus stops (statistics to July 2016)
